claim: QA round 22 on #946 (2026-11-11): mail_letter_rows' copy key strips angle brackets and white space from message_id before lower-casing, so '<id@x>' and 'id@x' from two doors are one letter; of several copies a non-DISCARDED one is the letter, so a set-aside first copy never hides the live one; a From whose mailbox is the row's vendor's book address (providers.contact_email or primary_contact.email) is never 'from a mail server' (a vendor at postmaster@ is the vendor), while deliveryReport/autoReplied still make it automatic; deliveryReport also reads X-Failed-Recipients (a plain-text MTA bounce). The migration doing this, mail_one_letter_whatever_door, must be the newest file defining mail_letter_rows, so no older definition overwrites it. Proven by supabase/tests/20270620100000_mail_one_letter_whatever_door_test.sql (D1-D5) and email-triage.spec.ts.
